pet-movie-poster 1.0.1

- No user-facing or internal changes detected in this version.
- All functionality and workflow remain unchanged.

An AI-powered pet poster tool that transforms a pet photo into a cinematic character poster by creating a themed hero image first and then composing a finished movie-style layout through the official Mew.design APIs. One-click transformation: Turns a pet into a fantasy, royal, heroic, or story-driven character while preserving its recognizable traits. Full poster output: Goes beyond a character edit by generating a complete movie-poster-style composition with title, atmosphere, and cinematic layout. Perfect for keepsakes and sharing: Ideal for pet lovers who want a polished, memorable visual starring their pet.
